title: PrestaShop Management
meta: A first round of PrestaShop upkeep: product edits, order checks, module updates and fixes. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: PrestaShop store management, a first round of upkeep
overview: Pass us the routine jobs in your PrestaShop back office for a first round. We catch up on product edits and uploads, update stock and prices, review recent orders and carrier settings, update modules that are behind and tidy up the back office. You receive a short report listing what we did and what needs your decision. Ongoing monthly management is quoted separately when you know how much help you need.
